workstation_id.description: ID to use for the workstation.
workstation_id.rationale: Workstation IDs should follow an approved naming standard so that resources can be clearly identified and managed consistently.
workstation_id.compliant: The workstation uses an approved workstation ID, such as work-station
workstation_id.non-compliant: The workstation uses an unapproved workstation ID, such as work-station1

workstation_config_id.description: The ID of the parent workstation cluster config.
workstation_config_id.rationale: Workstations should only use approved workstation configurations that follow the required security and operational standards.
workstation_config_id.compliant: The workstation uses an approved workstation_config_id, such as workstation-config
workstation_config_id.non-compliant: The workstation uses an unapproved workstation_config_id, such as wrong-config

workstation_cluster_id.description: The ID of the parent workstation cluster.
workstation_cluster_id.rationale: Workstations should be created only under approved workstation clusters to ensure they are managed within trusted infrastructure.
workstation_cluster_id.compliant: The workstation uses an approved workstation_cluster_id, such as workstation-cluster
workstation_cluster_id.non-compliant: The workstation uses an unapproved workstation_cluster_id, such as wrong-cluster

location.description: The location where the workstation parent resources reside.
location.rationale: Workstations should be deployed only in approved regions to meet organisational, compliance, and data governance requirements.
location.compliant: The workstation is deployed in an approved location, such as us-central1.
location.non-compliant: The workstation is deployed in an unapproved location, such as us-east1

display_name.rationale: Display name is mainly used as a human-readable identifier and does not directly control workstation security settings.

labels.description: Client-specified labels that are applied to the resource and that are also propagated to the underlying Compute Engine resources. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration. Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Labels are mainly used for organisation, identification, and cost tracking. They do not directly control access or security behaviour for the workstation.

annotations.description: Client-specified annotations. This is distinct from labels. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the annotations present in your configuration. Please refer to the field `effective_annotations` for all of the annotations present on the resource.
annotations.rationale: Annotation are to store extra metadata about workstation. They do not directly control access or security behaviour for the workstation

env.description: 'Client-specified environment variables passed to the workstation container's entrypoint.'
env.rationale: env does not affect security behaviour.

source_workstation.description: Full resource name of the source workstation from which the workstation's persistent directories will be cloned from during creation.
source_workstation.rationale: Source workstation cloning may affect data inheritance, but this policy set does not validate approved source workstations.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: The project can affect governance and resource ownership, but this workstation policy set does not validate approved project IDs.
